actions_performed: Inspected the request, archive members, live data, OS, kernel, and system health.
Validated requested paths and selectively extracted only those members.
Verified invoice hashes and modes, customer-register preservation, and absence of unrelated files.
Restarted node1 safely, confirmed its boot ID changed, and verified full system and data recovery.
Kept RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 unchanged; installed no software.

evidence.requirement: Restore the requested invoice bytes and file modes
evidence.summary: The archive listing establishes the requested files’ archived modes; extraction succeeded, and archive/live SHA-256 values match for both invoices with mode 0644.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the newer customer register and do not restore unrelated archived files
evidence.summary: customers.csv retained SHA-256 0f060a93… and its newer contents. The live tree contains exactly customers.csv and the two requested invoices; old-notes.txt remains absent, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after work, node1 reports RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.
